capabilities: Render PDF pages inside note code blocks with page ranges, scaling, DPI, rotation and partial-page windows
Draw graphic annotations (paths, lines, rectangles, text) on slides via a drawboard view
Write inline notes in the same block so they stay bound to the rendered pages
Set per-file rendering defaults through note front matter
Open the underlying PDF in a local viewer application
disambiguation: Not a presentation tool like the Slides core feature; it renders PDF slide files inside notes for annotation and study.
extras: The README warns the plugin is still under development and may make incompatible changes, and only supports the latest non-internal Obsidian version. The graphic annotation drawboard must be enabled manually in settings, and the optional better-pdf compatibility mode supports only a subset of better-pdf fields.
intentEvidence: This plugin is inspired by the better-pdf, but beyond rendering PDF pages.
problem: Obsidian's built-in PDF handling renders whole documents but offers no way to bind per-page graphic annotations and plaintext notes to specific slide pages in one block.

relations.evidence: This plugin is inspired by the better-pdf, but beyond rendering PDF pages.

summary: PDF slide note-taking plugin that renders PDF pages in code blocks, lets you draw graphic annotations, and keeps notes bound to slides.
